content.short: Signal21 is a Bitcoin-focused blockchain data and intelligence platform.
content.description: Signal21 brings together Bitcoin research and data from L1, L2, and Dapps in a single place, enabling both institutions and individuals to access comprehensive Bitcoin Economy analytics for trading, risk management, and rigorous research. The platform consolidates diverse data streams and tools, delivering a clear, unified view of on-chain activity, market signals, and asset dynamics across layers. With this centralized access, users can monitor exposure, test strategies, and deepen their understanding of Bitcoin-related markets and opportunities.
